name: Lilacs in the Breeze
source:
Thalia is a trans woman who left her old life behind months ago, finally able to feel free. As she acclimates to her new, slower-paced life, a rock gets thrown in her plans when her childhood friend shows up at her new workplace. Can she avoid his suspicion until he leaves? Or is there more to his arrival?

[From [url=https://crystalgameworks.itch.io/lilacs-in-the-breeze]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跨性别女性塔莉亚在数月前彻底告别了昔日的生活，终于得以呼吸自由的空气。正当她渐渐适应如今慢节奏的新生活时，昔日的青梅竹马却突然出现在她新入职的工作场所，打乱了她的全盘计划。在对方离开之前，她能否成功避开他的起疑？还是说，他的到来背后其实另有隐情？

[摘自[url=https://crystalgameworks.itch.io/lilacs-in-the-breeze]itch.io[/url]]
